excerpt: VSU Sp Cream is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as JK 09 11 08. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2016 as NSIC 2016 Sp34. It takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest, with 12.27 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about VSU Sp Cream sweet potato

blocks.caption: Key facts of VSU Sp Cream

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

VSU Sp Cream sweet potato takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 12.27 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against scab, weevil, so scout for them from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have cream with purple streaks flesh and red purple skin. Dry matter is 38.95 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 59.85 percent.
Where and when to plant VSU Sp Cream sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is JK 09 11 08 the same as VSU Sp Cream?
items.a: Yes. JK 09 11 08 is another name for VSU Sp Cream, registered as NSIC 2016 Sp34. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 12.27 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of VSU Sp Cream?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
